articles.headline: TRAI tightens rules as AI voice agents spread in business calling
articles.summary: India’s telecom regulator is moving to separate legitimate business calls from spam, scams, and impersonation as AI voice agents become more common. The rules matter for companies that rely on outbound calling, customer support, and automated sales because they raise compliance and operational requirements.

articles.headline: Boston Scientific says cyber incident may hit quarterly and full-year results
articles.summary: Boston Scientific disclosed that a cybersecurity incident is likely to have a material impact on its third-quarter and full-year results. For business leaders, the case highlights how cyber incidents can quickly become earnings, continuity, and disclosure issues rather than just IT problems.

articles.headline: September tech layoffs continue as firms cut staff to fund AI investment
articles.summary: Global tech layoffs accelerated in early September, with more than 5,000 roles cut in the first 10 days and major companies including Uber, PayPal, Apple, Zomato, and Oracle linked to reductions. The business takeaway is that companies are still rebalancing headcount toward AI and automation, which can affect hiring, vendor demand, and labor planning across the sector.
